Package cafe94.system.controller.staff

Class WaiterDashboardController

java.lang.Object
cafe94.system.controller.staff.WaiterDashboardController
public class WaiterDashboardController extends Object
Controller for the Waiter Dashboard in the Cafe94 system.

This dashboard allows waiters to:

  • Place eat-in orders on behalf of customers
  • View and manage outstanding orders (approve for delivery order only)
  • Manage customer bookings by approving them
Integrates with AppState, OutstandingOrderHelper, and DataSaver to support order filtering, menu item selection, and stateful UI updates.

  • Method Details

    • setup

      public void setup(OrderManaged orderManaged)
      Sets up the Waiter Dashboard with the shared order manager and populates order tables. Also shows the logged-in staff member's name.
      Parameters:
      orderManaged - The order manager containing all outstanding orders.

    • initialize

      private void initialize()
      Initializes the Waiter Dashboard UI components.

      Sets up all table views, combo boxes, listeners, and default values. This method is automatically called by JavaFX after the FXML is loaded.

    • handleAddMenu

      private void handleAddMenu()
      Adds the selected regular menu item and specified quantity to the basket. Refreshes the basket view to reflect the new item.

    • handleAddSpecial

      private void handleAddSpecial()
      Adds the selected daily special item and specified quantity to the basket. Refreshes the basket view to reflect the new item.

    • handleRemoveSelected

      private void handleRemoveSelected()
      Removes the selected item from the basket and updates the basket view.

    • handleConfirmOrder

      private void handleConfirmOrder()
      Confirms and places an Eat-In order for the selected customer using the current basket items. Clears the basket after saving.

    • refreshBasket

      private void refreshBasket()
      Refreshes the basket TableView and updates the total label based on current basket items.

    • loadOrders

      private void loadOrders(String filterType)
      Loads and filters outstanding orders based on the selected filter type. Waiters typically see either all outstanding orders or those relevant to their role.
      Parameters:
      filterType - The filter criteria selected in the UI.

    • handleApprove

      private void handleApprove()
      Approves a delivery order that is currently in PENDING_APPROVAL status. Once approved, its status is updated to PENDING_PREP and saved to file.

    • handleBookingApprove

      private void handleBookingApprove()
      Handles approval of a selected customer booking. If the booking is not already approved, updates its status to APPROVED, saves the changes, and refreshes the booking table.

    • handleLogout

      private void handleLogout()
      Handles the logout action for the waiter. Redirects the user back to the welcome login screen.

    • clearOtherSelections

      private void clearOtherSelections(javafx.scene.control.TableView<?>... tables)
      Clears selection across multiple tables to avoid accidental multi-selection.
      Parameters:
      tables - Tables to clear selection from.

      private void showInfo(String msg)
